endres-bifti_demo-001.description: Demonstration data for the NIfTI phantom format: a synthetic brain-like phantom (single slice) plus geometric-shape phantoms on their native grid and resliced.

duarte-breast-001.description: Breast digital twin phantom for 3T and 7T field strengths, both multi-slice and single slice.

zaiss-brainweb_subj04_3T_0.5mm-001.description: anatomical brain model (subj04) from the BrainWeb Simulated Brain Database (McGill BIC; Aubert-Broche et al., IEEE TMI 2006) at 3T, full 3D volume and single-slice transversal/coronal/sagittal variants.

endres-brainweb_highres-001.description: 20 anatomical brain models from the BrainWeb Simulated Brain Database (McGill BIC; Aubert-Broche et al., IEEE TMI 2006) at 3T and 7T, in three resolutions (0.5/1/2 mm) each as a full 3D volume and single-slice transversal/coronal/sagittal variants, organized as nested groups (subject > field strength/resolution).

endres-brainweb-001.description: 1mm and 2mm variants of the 20 anatomical brain models from the BrainWeb Simulated Brain Database (McGill BIC; Aubert-Broche et al., IEEE TMI 2006) at 3T and 7T, downsampled from collection-brainweb's native 0.5mm data by averaging 2x2x2 voxel blocks (1mm is native resolution; 2mm is resampled from it on load). Same nested layout as collection-brainweb (subject > field strength/resolution), without the large native 0.5mm data.
